description: Plagueheart Bindings Level 60 Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Bindings if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal. Requirements: - Desecrated Bindings - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 6 - Arcane Crystal - Nexus Crystal
